description: Browse the catalog of 300+ audit rules that run during an audit, grouped into categories (crawlability, meta tags, performance, security, accessibility, content, and more). Filter by category code or search by keyword to find what a specific rule checks. Each rule carries cloud (credit-metered), requires_cloud (reads a cloud-backed step) and requires_render (reads the headless-browser render step, skipped on a run with render off). Use get_rule for one rule's full detail.

category.description: Filter to one category code (codes: call with include_categories: true).

include_categories.description: Include the categories list (code, name, rule_count). Default: off.

search.description: Case-insensitive keyword match on rule id, name, and description.

name: list_rules
title: List audit rules
